description_en: Updates the attributes, including the name, of a Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance
description_zh: 更新网络型负载均衡实例名称等属性
kebab_example: aliyun nlb update-load-balancer-attribute --load-balancer-id nlb-wb7r6dlwetvt5j0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateLoadBalancerAttribute

parameters.help_zh: 网络型负载均衡实例的ID
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

parameters.help_en:
The NLB instance name.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter
parameters.help_zh:
网络型负载均衡实例名称。

长度为2~128个英文或中文字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: load_balancer_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable cross-zone load balancing for the NLB instance. Valid values:

true
false
parameters.help_zh:
网络型负载均衡实例是否开启跨可用区。取值：

true：开启。
false：关闭
parameters.name: cross_zone_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run, without sending the actual request. Valid values:

true: performs only a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request syntax, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and sends the actual request. If the request passes the dry run, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会更新实例信息。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token. Ensure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the request ID as the client token. The request ID is different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the NLB instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
网络型负载均衡实例所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of new connections per second in each zone supported by the NLB instance (virtual IP address). Valid values: 1 to 1000000
parameters.help_zh: 网络型负载均衡实例在每个可用区（VIP）处理的每秒新建连接限速值。取值范围：1~1000000
parameters.name: cps
